name: Video Storyboard Production
description: Narration-first AI video production methods for continuity inventory, semantic shot design, model-aware prompting, MiniMax H3/ComfyUI execution planning, and generated-video review.

source.license: Adaptation; upstream MIT + ISC, see NOTICE.md

skills.name: Narration Production Orchestrator
skills.description: Orchestrate finalized narration into a complete production plan, delegating continuity, shot design, prompt assembly, ComfyUI execution planning, and review in the correct order.

skills.name: Continuity Inventory
skills.description: Freeze continuity-critical people, places, motifs, props, spatial relationships, and state changes before shot writing.

skills.name: Narration to Storyboard
skills.description: Reverse-engineer finalized spoken narration into semantically accountable visual beats and generation-sized storyboard units without rewriting the narration.

skills.name: Shot Specifier
skills.description: Specify visual evidence, composition, blocking, camera motion, timing, start/end state and transition anchors for each shot.

skills.name: MiniMax H3 Prompt and Workflow
skills.description: Compile storyboard shots into MiniMax H3 prompts and ComfyUI job specifications with valid frame grids, keyframe strategy, retake boundaries, native-resolution provenance, and continuity handoffs.

skills.name: Generated Video Review
skills.description: Audit generated takes against narration semantics, continuity, visible causality, composition, technical provenance, and retake scope before assembly.
